# Shared country storage migration — 25 September 2026

## Scope and preservation

Stage 2 depends on shared-instruction PR #62. Migration source is main bb909efb8cb1816f75cee338e06589a8abc7b012, including PR #61 Sweden PTS2025 evidence. Ninety old domain records become 36 canonical jurisdiction files. Every expanded domain matches its original parsed JSON exactly, verified before deletion and through frozen per-record SHA256 acceptance fingerprints. This includes all 651 monitoring/enforcement claim objects (including the new Sweden claims), 27 sanctions note/history records, all source details, dates, questions and qualifications. Evidence objects are coalesced only when completely identical. Different passages/dates/types at one URL remain distinct. Domain schemas and verification meanings are retained, not flattened.

Six pre-existing monitoring-schema errors affect five unchanged claims: missing reporting-route objects for Greece, Poland, Romania and Slovenia; one Slovenian source has legacy fields/missing accessed_on. Exceptions are exact claim/error fingerprints bound to a fixed digest. New/changed claims cannot inherit them. No evidence statuses or dates were upgraded to make checks pass.

Public prose is unchanged. Only the Estonia local research link and its current reviewed row hash change. Sanctions and monitoring public pages are byte-identical; enforcement frozen baseline is byte-identical. Historical reports/snapshots remain preserved. Country deliveries own evidence-routing decisions; events.json is generated compatibility output. Watcher inventory gains current domain/claim references, preserving historical blob/path/index provenance. No runtime state, lease, notification history, schedule or cloud configuration is changed.

## Validation

Shared JSON Schema/references/routing and migration fingerprint checks pass: 36 countries, 651 claims, 16 delivery events. Nine new storage-boundary tests pass, including lossless projection, missing references, evidence mutation, duplicate IDs, frozen-exception limits, routing domain/index consistency and domain isolation. Existing 26 enforcement, five sanctions and nine watcher tests pass: 49 total. Markdownlint, whitespace and local-link checks pass; verification-date script reports no markers. Domain validators preserve publication gates. Read-only repository smoke checks also resolve all five watcher country/domain records and their current claim IDs; all 16 routing events retain original decisions/PRs/reasons except record/domain relocation. These do not verify deployed cloud prompts. Structural tests are not legal/source verification. No new factual research or language review is required for unchanged factual wording.
